description:
Small core PR (soundness path: scripts/site_inputs.py).

The docs link to 183 tracked core files outside docs/ (99 TPC-DS .tpl templates, 61 .py, 22 .sql, 1 .ini; about 0.9 MB). The site publishes each at /docs/_downloads/<md5>/<name>. The bundle lists them in repo-files.json but carries no contents, so the site build cannot publish them.

1. In `scripts/site_inputs.py`, add a `downloads/` member: every tracked file outside docs/ that a Markdown link target in a tracked `docs/**/*.md` file resolves to (inline links, reference definitions and autolinks; fragments and queries stripped; schemes and site-absolute paths skipped; .md and .rst excluded). Copy each to `downloads/<repo-relative path>`.
2. Bump the bundle schema to 2: `downloads` joins the required member set, and `cmd_verify` checks it.
3. Tests for the link scan (relative, reference-style, fragment, outside vs inside docs, untracked target ignored) and for verify.
4. The site adds schema 2 to its supported set and keeps schema 1 (N and N-1). Core lands first.
